changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.comment: Remove custom API-key grants which exceed the grants of the key's owning team. New writes enforce this boundary in the service.
changeSet.sql:
DELETE FROM api_key_model_permissions akmp USING api_keys ak WHERE akmp.api_key_id = ak.id AND ak.team_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_model_permissions tmp WHERE tmp.team_id = ak.team_id AND tmp.model_id = akmp.model_id );
DELETE FROM api_key_provider_permissions akpp USING api_keys ak WHERE akpp.api_key_id = ak.id AND ak.team_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_provider_permissions tpp WHERE tpp.team_id = ak.team_id AND tpp.provider_id = akpp.provider_id );
